calibration.note: Calibration is judged on whether the two readers' counts are within one point and their categorical judgements match. Practice answers were hand-written and never enter a result.

cases.note: A case is held if either reader answered 'no' to any check. Held cases are repaired or dropped now, before generation; nothing is dropped after answers exist.

readers_labelled: positionally by filename (reader_A, reader_B); no identity stored
